ns2:course.label: Undergraduate Seminar in Art History
ns2:course.description: Seminar offering students practical experience in research methods in Art History. Focuses on a specialized theme of the professor's choice, and incorporates extensive reading in a specific field of Art History and the completion of a substantial research paper. 3 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit. May be repeated if topics vary.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 3 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit. May be repeated if topics vary.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing.
